checks.name: G1_sqrt_det
checks.detail: sqrt|g| = b4^3 cos z on 0 < z < pi/2 (b4^3 |cos z| on the whole cell); a4 cancels

checks.name: G1_y_chart
checks.detail: y = ln|sin z|/(6H): dy = cot z dx0, so g00 dx0^2 = dy^2 and S = e^{2Hy}: ds^2 = dy^2 + e^{2Hy}(e^{2a4} dx_i^2 - e^{-2a4} b4^2 dx_t^2) - dx4^2, sqrt|g| = b4^3 e^{6Hy}

checks.name: G2_curvature_free_of_x0
checks.detail: 39 non-zero frame components R^{ab}_{cd} (a<b, c<d), none depends on x0

checks.name: G2_mixed_components
checks.detail: the only other components: R^{0i}_{4i} = R^{4i}_{0i} sign = H^2 A (i = x1, x2, x3) and R^{0t}_{4t} = H^2 (A - U) (t = x5, x6, x7), with the frame of x0 oriented along cot z (12 components counting both pair orders)

checks.name: G3_structure
checks.detail: every E_(p) has only the diagonal components and the (x0, x4) pair

checks.name: G3_free_of_x0
checks.detail: no frame component of E_(1), E_(2), E_(3) depends on x0

checks.name: G3_einstein_two_routes
checks.detail: E_(1) from the generalised delta equals R^M_N - delta R/2 from the coordinate Ricci tensor (converted to the frame)

checks.name: G3_trace_identity
checks.detail: E_(p)^a_a = -(8 - 2p)/2 L_(p) for p = 1, 2, 3 with L_(p) from its own sum

checks.name: G3_bianchi_identity
checks.detail: nabla_M E_(p)^M_N = 0 identically (all N, p = 1, 2, 3) for general a4(x4), b4(x4)

checks.name: G3_gauss_bonnet_explicit
checks.detail: E_(2) equals the explicit Gauss-Bonnet tensor 2(R R_ab - 2R_ac R^c_b - 2R_acbd R^cd + R_a^cde R_bcde) - eta_ab L_GB/2 at 4 random points

checks.name: G3_second_quarter
checks.detail: on pi/2 < z < pi (cot z < 0, h0 = -cot z) every component is the same except that those with one x0 frame index change sign (the fold reflection)

checks.name: G4_author_vacuum
checks.detail: a4 = H x4, b4 constant (A = 1, U = 0) solves the vacuum equations with w = (1, 1/32, 1/1152), Lambda = -10 H^2 (the author's eternal inflation/deflation, Dirac_Einstein-Lovelock_4+4_Nash.nb In[134])

checks.name: G4_offdiagonal_factor
checks.detail: the (x0, x4) equation: -(3/16) U G(A, U) H^2 = kappa T^{x0}_{x4} with G = 5A^2(A - U)^2 - 6A^2 + 6AU + U^2 + 1

checks.name: G4_vacuum_degenerate
checks.detail: near the vacuum the energy constraint is kappa rho = -H^2 P44, P44 = (3/4)[(delta - U)^2 + delta^2] + O(3), delta = A - 1: the linear terms vanish (the effective Newton constant is zero at the vacuum) and kappa rho <= 0 to second order

checks.name: G4_constant_b4
checks.detail: with b4 constant: P44 = (A^2 - 1)^2 (5A^2 + 1)/16 >= 0, so kappa rho <= 0 for every expansion rate

checks.name: G4_diagonal_source_branches
checks.detail: G(A, U) = 0 has real roots U only for 5A^4 - 10A^2 + 1 <= 0, i.e. 0.3249 <= |A| <= 1.3764; at A = 1 the roots are U = 0 and U = 2/3

checks.name: G4_frozen_extra_times
checks.detail: with e^{-a4} b4 constant (U = A): kappa rho = (3A^2 - 1) H^2/16, kappa T^{x0}_{x4} = -(3/16) A (1 + A^2) H^2 and kappa(rho + p_1) = -(6 + 6A^2 + 2Ad) H^2/16 < 0 (the null energy condition is violated unless a4 < -3(1 + A^2) H^2)

checks.name: G4_static_space
checks.detail: static 3-space (A = 0): kappa rho = (3U^2 - 1) H^2/16, positive only for |b4'/b4| > H/sqrt 3

checks.name: G5_spin_connection_antisymmetric
checks.detail: omega_{M ab} = -omega_{M ba} (metric compatibility)

checks.name: G5_gamma_Omega
checks.detail: gamma^M Omega_M = 3H T^(x0) + (3/2)(b4'/b4) T^(x4) on 0 < z < pi/2 (T^a = eta^aa T_a; on the second half the first term is -3H T^(x0) with the frame of x0 along cot z): the gravitational coupling of dirac16complex through the canonical spin connection is never identically zero (H > 0)

checks.name: G5_vielbein_postulate
checks.detail: D_M gamma^N = 0 (the gamma matrices are covariantly constant with the canonical spin connection)
